nodes.label: Three-Stage Command Dispatch Chain
nodes.rationale: Every command goes through builtin → plugin → fork+exec in sequence. Redirection applied at every stage with appropriate fd strategy (save/restore for builtins/plugins, child-only for external).

nodes.label: Zero External Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Stripped binary ~39K, startup ~2ms. Every feature hand-rolled in C — no libreadline, no libffi, no JSON library. Adding a dependency must justify the bloat.

nodes.label: Custom Line Editor vs libreadline
nodes.rationale: Rather than pull in readline (~200K, GPL), quip has a ~120-line editor in prompt.c. Lacks kill-ring, vi-mode, multi-byte — acceptable for a personal shell.

nodes.label: Lazy Python Daemon
nodes.rationale: Daemon forks on first plugin use, not shell startup. Shell starts in ~2ms regardless of plugin count. First plugin call pays ~100ms penalty.

nodes.label: Abstract Unix Socket for Plugin IPC
nodes.rationale: Linux abstract socket avoids filesystem entry (no stale socket cleanup) and needs no special permissions. Downside: Linux-only; macOS/FreeBSD would need path-based socket.
nodes.norm_label: abstract unix socket for plugin ipc

nodes.label: Fork-Exec Model for External Commands
nodes.rationale: fork() + execvp() gives direct control over signal dispositions and fd manipulation in the child, critical for pipeline plumbing and redirection. Heavier than posix_spawn() on some kernels.

nodes.label: Builtin Redirection via fd Save-Restore
nodes.rationale: Builtins/plugins run in the shell process, so redirection must be applied then undone: fflush → dup() → dup2() → execute → fflush → dup2() back. Avoids spawning a process for echo > file.

nodes.label: Multiline via Backslash and Quote Tracking
nodes.rationale: Enter checks odd backslash count and odd double-quote count for continuation. Simpler than a full parser state machine (heredocs, $() nesting) but covers common interactive cases.
nodes.norm_label: multiline via backslash and quote tracking

nodes.label: No Job Control Signals (SIGTSTP Ignored)
nodes.rationale: SIGTSTP (Ctrl-Z) ignored. Backgrounding via & syntax and bg/fg builtins only. Avoids terminal process-group complexity; Ctrl-Z does nothing (tradeoff).
